_readme: Source data for docs/benchmarks/set_algebra/results/bench_domain_algebra.svg rendered by docs/benchmarks/set_algebra/scripts/generate_charts.py. Provenance is per-section: each block below states its own harness and issue, and records host/commit as "unresolved" where the source did not distinguish them. A section whose host is unresolved must not be paired with another in prose or in a ratio (AGENTS.md 8.12).

meta.attribution: Panels 1-2 (#348, #610, benches/search_boolean.rs) retain unresolved host and commit: they were NOT re-measured by this work and keep the position recorded in #646. Panel 3 (#611, benches/domain.rs) was re-measured on the reference host after the per-iteration leak fix (#647); its provenance is stated per section above. The two panel groups therefore carry different provenance and must not be compared.
meta.note: Set algebra evolution (#348 materialization, #610 k-way aggregate) from benches/search_boolean.rs, and the interned set domain (#611) from benches/domain.rs. Two harnesses: the panels are not a paired comparison and must not be read as one.

domain_parity_611._note: Paired ratio domain/raw per repetition; interval is a percentile bootstrap over independent runs, so it carries between-run variance. Criterion's own within-run interval is 0.2-0.5% here and cannot see that, which is why single-run figures appeared separated when they were not (AGENTS.md 8.4).

domain_resolution_611._note: N=100k agrees: 164.06 us total, 1.641 ns/key, 609.5 M keys/s.
